title: 多視角全像顯示校正
summary: 從光場顯示的角取樣與全像的空間頻寬積出發，理解斜向柱狀透鏡、繞射式背光與眼動追蹤顯示為何必須逐台校正，再把摩爾相移映射、串擾與亮度漣波、熱漂移、延遲與深度驗收整合成可交接的多視角顯示校正工程。
summaryEn: Start from the angular sampling of light-field displays and the space–bandwidth product of holography to see why slanted-lenticular, diffractive-backlight and eye-tracked displays must each be calibrated unit by unit, then integrate moiré phase-shift mapping, crosstalk and luminance ripple, thermal drift, latency and depth acceptance into a transferable multiview calibration record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「光場角取樣、視點數與景深預算」與「空間頻寬積與全像視角」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Light-field angular sampling, view count and depth budget" and "Space–bandwidth product and holographic viewing angle": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 光場角取樣、視點數與景深預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Light-field angular sampling, view count and depth budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「視角錐與角取樣」如何決定多視角全像顯示校正的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “View cone and angular sampling” determines the key performance of “Multiview holographic-display calibration”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多視角顯示把面板像素分配給不同的出射方向：每個透鏡或光學單元下方的子像素各自對應一個視點，觀察者兩眼落在不同視點便看到雙眼視差，頭部移動時則看到運動視差。面板總像素數固定，所以視點數 N 與每個視點的空間解析度直接互換；視角錐被切成 N 份，角取樣間隔 Δθ 決定能重現多深的立體內容。距螢幕平面 z 的點在相鄰視點間位移 z·Δθ，一旦超過透鏡節距影像便開始模糊，因此深度預算是角取樣的直接後果，而不是渲染軟體的設定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「視角錐與角取樣」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A multiview display distributes panel pixels over emission directions: the subpixels beneath each lens or optical cell each feed one view, so two eyes landing in different views see binocular parallax and head motion reveals motion parallax. The panel pixel count is fixed, so the view count N trades directly against per-view spatial resolution; the view cone is cut into N slices and the angular pitch Δθ decides how deep the reproducible 3D content can be. A point at distance z from the screen plane shifts by z·Δθ between adjacent views, and once that exceeds the lens pitch the image blurs, so the depth budget is a direct consequence of angular sampling, not a rendering setting. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “View cone and angular sampling”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a 40° view cone and N = 45 views, Δθ = 40°/45 = 0.889° = 0.0155 rad; a 3840×2160 panel leaves only 8.29×10⁶/45 ≈ 1.84×10⁵ pixels per view (about 576×320).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「視點數越多越好，增加視點不會犧牲任何東西。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More views are always better; adding views costs nothing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「視角錐與角取樣」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “View cone and angular sampling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 光場角取樣、視點數與景深預算
knowledge.titleEn: Light-field angular sampling, view count and depth budget
knowledge.text: 多視角顯示把面板像素分配給不同的出射方向：每個透鏡或光學單元下方的子像素各自對應一個視點，觀察者兩眼落在不同視點便看到雙眼視差，頭部移動時則看到運動視差。面板總像素數固定，所以視點數 N 與每個視點的空間解析度直接互換；視角錐被切成 N 份，角取樣間隔 Δθ 決定能重現多深的立體內容。
knowledge.textEn: A multiview display distributes panel pixels over emission directions: the subpixels beneath each lens or optical cell each feed one view, so two eyes landing in different views see binocular parallax and head motion reveals motion parallax. The panel pixel count is fixed, so the view count N trades directly against per-view spatial resolution; the view cone is cut into N slices and the angular pitch Δθ decides how deep the reproducible 3D content can be.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：視點數越多越好，增加視點不會犧牲任何東西。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More views are always better; adding views costs nothing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「光場角取樣、視點數與景深預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Light-field angular sampling, view count and depth budget" is correct?
options: 視點數越多越好，增加視點不會犧牲任何東西。
多視角顯示把面板像素分配給不同的出射方向：每個透鏡或光學單元下方的子像素各自對應一個視點，觀察者兩眼落在不同視點便看到雙眼視差，頭部移動時則看到運動視差。
只要加大透鏡，就能同時得到大螢幕與大視角的全像。
optionsEn: More views are always better; adding views costs nothing.

A multiview display distributes panel pixels over emission directions: the subpixels beneath each lens or optical cell each feed one view, so two eyes landing in different views see binocular parallax and head motion reveals motion parallax.
A bigger lens gives a hologram both a large screen and a wide viewing angle.
quiz.explanation: 多視角顯示把面板像素分配給不同的出射方向：每個透鏡或光學單元下方的子像素各自對應一個視點，觀察者兩眼落在不同視點便看到雙眼視差，頭部移動時則看到運動視差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A multiview display distributes panel pixels over emission directions: the subpixels beneath each lens or optical cell each feed one view, so two eyes landing in different views see binocular parallax and head motion reveals motion parallax. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 光場角取樣、視點數與景深預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Light-field angular sampling, view count and depth budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「視角錐與角取樣」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “View cone and angular sampling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：視角錐 40°、N = 45 視點：Δθ = 40°/45 = 0.889° = 0.0155 rad；3840×2160 面板每視點只剩 8.29×10⁶/45 ≈ 1.84×10⁵ 像素（約 576×320）。透鏡節距 s = 0.40 mm 時，模糊等於一個節距的深度 z = s/Δθ = 0.40/0.0155 ≈ 26 mm；放在 60 mm 處的內容模糊 60×0.0155 ≈ 0.93 mm，約 2.3 個節距。觀看距離 600 mm 時相鄰視點在眼睛處相距 9.3 mm，63 mm 瞳距橫跨約 6.8 個視點。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a 40° view cone and N = 45 views, Δθ = 40°/45 = 0.889° = 0.0155 rad; a 3840×2160 panel leaves only 8.29×10⁶/45 ≈ 1.84×10⁵ pixels per view (about 576×320). With a lens pitch s = 0.40 mm the depth at which blur equals one pitch is z = s/Δθ = 0.40/0.0155 ≈ 26 mm; content at 60 mm blurs by 60×0.0155 ≈ 0.93 mm, about 2.3 pitches. At a 600 mm viewing distance adjacent views are 9.3 mm apart at the eye, so a 63 mm interpupillary distance spans about 6.8 views. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把相機架在 600 mm 的旋轉臂或線性滑軌上，逐度移動並拍攝只點亮單一視點的測試圖，記錄每個視點出現的角位置，求出實際視角錐寬度與平均 Δθ；再渲染放在 0、20、40、60 mm 深度的細線靶，量影像線寬對深度的曲線，應在約 26 mm 之後開始隨 z·Δθ 線性增寬。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mount a camera on a rotary arm or linear rail at 600 mm, step it degree by degree while photographing a test image that lights a single view, and log the angle at which each view appears to obtain the actual cone width and mean Δθ; then render fine-line targets at depths of 0, 20, 40 and 60 mm and measure line width versus depth, which should begin to grow linearly as z·Δθ beyond roughly 26 mm.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 視角錐 40°、N = 45 視點：Δθ = 40°/45 = 0.889° = 0.0155 rad；3840×2160 面板每視點只剩 8.29×10⁶/45 ≈ 1.84×10⁵ 像素（約 576×320）。透鏡節距 s = 0.40 mm 時，模糊等於一個節距的深度 z = s/Δθ = 0.40/0.0155 ≈ 26 mm；放在 60 mm 處的內容模糊 60×0.0155 ≈ 0.93 mm，約 2.3 個節距。觀看距離 600 mm 時相鄰視點在眼睛處相距 9.3 mm，63 mm 瞳距橫跨約 6.8 個視點。
knowledge.textEn: With a 40° view cone and N = 45 views, Δθ = 40°/45 = 0.889° = 0.0155 rad; a 3840×2160 panel leaves only 8.29×10⁶/45 ≈ 1.84×10⁵ pixels per view (about 576×320). With a lens pitch s = 0.40 mm the depth at which blur equals one pitch is z = s/Δθ = 0.40/0.0155 ≈ 26 mm; content at 60 mm blurs by 60×0.0155 ≈ 0.93 mm, about 2.3 pitches. At a 600 mm viewing distance adjacent views are 9.3 mm apart at the eye, so a 63 mm interpupillary distance spans about 6.8 views.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「光場角取樣、視點數與景深預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Light-field angular sampling, view count and depth budget", which statement holds?
options: 繞射背光的視點方向只由光柵週期決定，與光源無關。
串擾越低，多視角顯示的觀看體驗就一定越好。
optionsEn: A diffractive backlight's view directions depend only on grating period, not the source.
Lower crosstalk always means a better multiview viewing experience.
With a 40° view cone and N = 45 views, Δθ = 40°/45 = 0.889° = 0.0155 rad; a 3840×2160 panel leaves only 8.29×10⁶/45 ≈ 1.84×10⁵ pixels per view (about 576×320).
quiz.explanationEn: With a 40° view cone and N = 45 views, Δθ = 40°/45 = 0.889° = 0.0155 rad; a 3840×2160 panel leaves only 8.29×10⁶/45 ≈ 1.84×10⁵ pixels per view (about 576×320). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 光場角取樣、視點數與景深預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Light-field angular sampling, view count and depth budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「視角錐與角取樣」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “View cone and angular sampling” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把相機架在 600 mm 的旋轉臂或線性滑軌上，逐度移動並拍攝只點亮單一視點的測試圖，記錄每個視點出現的角位置，求出實際視角錐寬度與平均 Δθ；再渲染放在 0、20、40、60 mm 深度的細線靶，量影像線寬對深度的曲線，應在約 26 mm 之後開始隨 z·Δθ 線性增寬。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mount a camera on a rotary arm or linear rail at 600 mm, step it degree by degree while photographing a test image that lights a single view, and log the angle at which each view appears to obtain the actual cone width and mean Δθ; then render fine-line targets at depths of 0, 20, 40 and 60 mm and measure line width versus depth, which should begin to grow linearly as z·Δθ beyond roughly 26 mm. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：內容團隊把物件放到螢幕前 100 mm 製造跳出效果，模糊達 1.55 mm（近 4 個節距），邊緣出現多重疊影；使用者抱怨失焦，工程團隊卻去重新貼合面板與透鏡，把時間浪費在不是根因的地方。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A content team places objects 100 mm in front of the screen for a pop-out effect, the blur reaches 1.55 mm (nearly four pitches) and edges show multiple ghost copies; users complain of defocus and engineering wastes time re-bonding the lens to the panel, which is not the root cause.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把相機架在 600 mm 的旋轉臂或線性滑軌上，逐度移動並拍攝只點亮單一視點的測試圖，記錄每個視點出現的角位置，求出實際視角錐寬度與平均 Δθ；再渲染放在 0、20、40、60 mm 深度的細線靶，量影像線寬對深度的曲線，應在約 26 mm 之後開始隨 z·Δθ 線性增寬。
knowledge.textEn: Mount a camera on a rotary arm or linear rail at 600 mm, step it degree by degree while photographing a test image that lights a single view, and log the angle at which each view appears to obtain the actual cone width and mean Δθ; then render fine-line targets at depths of 0, 20, 40 and 60 mm and measure line width versus depth, which should begin to grow linearly as z·Δθ beyond roughly 26 mm.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光場角取樣、視點數與景深預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Light-field angular sampling, view count and depth budget"?
options: 把相機架在 600 mm 的旋轉臂或線性滑軌上，逐度移動並拍攝只點亮單一視點的測試圖，記錄每個視點出現的角位置，求出實際視角錐寬度與平均 Δθ。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要眼動追蹤夠準，延遲幾十毫秒不影響立體感。
optionsEn: Mount a camera on a rotary arm or linear rail at 600 mm, step it degree by degree while photographing a test image that lights a single view, and log the angle at which each view appears to obtain the actual cone width and mean Δθ.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If eye tracking is accurate, tens of milliseconds of latency do not affect the 3D effect.
quiz.explanation: 把相機架在 600 mm 的旋轉臂或線性滑軌上，逐度移動並拍攝只點亮單一視點的測試圖，記錄每個視點出現的角位置，求出實際視角錐寬度與平均 Δθ；再渲染放在 0、20、40、60 mm 深度的細線靶，量影像線寬對深度的曲線，應在約 26 mm 之後開始隨 z·Δθ 線性增寬。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mount a camera on a rotary arm or linear rail at 600 mm, step it degree by degree while photographing a test image that lights a single view, and log the angle at which each view appears to obtain the actual cone width and mean Δθ; then render fine-line targets at depths of 0, 20, 40 and 60 mm and measure line width versus depth, which should begin to grow linearly as z·Δθ beyond roughly 26 mm. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 光場角取樣、視點數與景深預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Light-field angular sampling, view count and depth budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「視角錐與角取樣」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “View cone and angular sampling” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 內容團隊把物件放到螢幕前 100 mm 製造跳出效果，模糊達 1.55 mm（近 4 個節距），邊緣出現多重疊影；使用者抱怨失焦，工程團隊卻去重新貼合面板與透鏡，把時間浪費在不是根因的地方。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A content team places objects 100 mm in front of the screen for a pop-out effect, the blur reaches 1.55 mm (nearly four pitches) and edges show multiple ghost copies; users complain of defocus and engineering wastes time re-bonding the lens to the panel, which is not the root cause. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：距螢幕平面 z 的點在相鄰視點間位移 z·Δθ，一旦超過透鏡節距影像便開始模糊，因此深度預算是角取樣的直接後果，而不是渲染軟體的設定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A point at distance z from the screen plane shifts by z·Δθ between adjacent views, and once that exceeds the lens pitch the image blurs, so the depth budget is a direct consequence of angular sampling, not a rendering setting.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「視點數越多越好，增加視點不會犧牲任何東西。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More views are always better; adding views costs nothing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 內容團隊把物件放到螢幕前 100 mm 製造跳出效果，模糊達 1.55 mm（近 4 個節距），邊緣出現多重疊影；使用者抱怨失焦，工程團隊卻去重新貼合面板與透鏡，把時間浪費在不是根因的地方。
knowledge.textEn: A content team places objects 100 mm in front of the screen for a pop-out effect, the blur reaches 1.55 mm (nearly four pitches) and edges show multiple ghost copies; users complain of defocus and engineering wastes time re-bonding the lens to the panel, which is not the root cause.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「光場角取樣、視點數與景深預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Light-field angular sampling, view count and depth budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
內容團隊把物件放到螢幕前 100 mm 製造跳出效果，模糊達 1.55 mm（近 4 個節距），邊緣出現多重疊影。
只要加大透鏡，就能同時得到大螢幕與大視角的全像。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A content team places objects 100 mm in front of the screen for a pop-out effect, the blur reaches 1.55 mm (nearly four pitches) and edges show multiple ghost copies.
A bigger lens gives a hologram both a large screen and a wide viewing angle.
quiz.explanation: 內容團隊把物件放到螢幕前 100 mm 製造跳出效果，模糊達 1.55 mm（近 4 個節距），邊緣出現多重疊影；使用者抱怨失焦，工程團隊卻去重新貼合面板與透鏡，把時間浪費在不是根因的地方。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A content team places objects 100 mm in front of the screen for a pop-out effect, the blur reaches 1.55 mm (nearly four pitches) and edges show multiple ghost copies; users complain of defocus and engineering wastes time re-bonding the lens to the panel, which is not the root cause. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 空間頻寬積與全像視角：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Space–bandwidth product and holographic viewing angle: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「SLM 像素節距與繞射錐」如何決定多視角全像顯示校正的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “SLM pixel pitch and diffraction cone” determines the key performance of “Multiview holographic-display calibration”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 真正的全像顯示以空間光調制器重建波前，最大繞射角由像素節距決定：sinθ = λ/(2p)。視窗寬度 W 與視角 2θ 的乘積受空間頻寬積 N = W·2sinθ/λ 限制，而這個數正好等於該方向的像素數，因此像素數固定時螢幕越大視角越小，反之亦然。這個守恆與光展量（étendue）同源，透鏡或擴束器只能在 W 與 θ 之間交換，不能同時增加兩者。多視角全像必須逐視角校正，因為每個觀看方向只用到總頻寬中的一個子孔徑，各子孔徑的像差與相位誤差並不相同。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「SLM 像素節距與繞射錐」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A true holographic display reconstructs a wavefront with a spatial light modulator whose maximum diffraction angle is set by the pixel pitch: sinθ = λ/(2p). The product of window width W and viewing angle 2θ is bounded by the space–bandwidth product N = W·2sinθ/λ, which equals the pixel count along that axis, so for a fixed pixel count a larger screen means a narrower viewing angle and vice versa. This conservation has the same root as optical étendue: lenses or beam expanders only trade W against θ and never raise both. Multiview holograms must be calibrated view by view because each viewing direction uses only a sub-aperture of the total bandwidth, and the aberration and phase error of each sub-aperture differ. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “SLM pixel pitch and diffraction cone”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 4K LCOS with p = 3.74 µm and λ = 532 nm, sinθ = 0.532/7.48 = 0.0711, θ = 4.08° and the full viewing angle is only 8.2°; W = 4096×3.74 µm = 15.3 mm and N = 15.3 mm×0.142/532 nm ≈ 4096.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要加大透鏡，就能同時得到大螢幕與大視角的全像。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A bigger lens gives a hologram both a large screen and a wide viewing angle." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「SLM 像素節距與繞射錐」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “SLM pixel pitch and diffraction cone”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 空間頻寬積與全像視角
knowledge.titleEn: Space–bandwidth product and holographic viewing angle
knowledge.text: 真正的全像顯示以空間光調制器重建波前，最大繞射角由像素節距決定：sinθ = λ/(2p)。視窗寬度 W 與視角 2θ 的乘積受空間頻寬積 N = W·2sinθ/λ 限制，而這個數正好等於該方向的像素數，因此像素數固定時螢幕越大視角越小，反之亦然。
knowledge.textEn: A true holographic display reconstructs a wavefront with a spatial light modulator whose maximum diffraction angle is set by the pixel pitch: sinθ = λ/(2p). The product of window width W and viewing angle 2θ is bounded by the space–bandwidth product N = W·2sinθ/λ, which equals the pixel count along that axis, so for a fixed pixel count a larger screen means a narrower viewing angle and vice versa.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要加大透鏡，就能同時得到大螢幕與大視角的全像。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A bigger lens gives a hologram both a large screen and a wide viewing angle. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「空間頻寬積與全像視角」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Space–bandwidth product and holographic viewing angle" is correct?
options: 只要加大透鏡，就能同時得到大螢幕與大視角的全像。
透鏡節距照設計圖加工，校正時直接用設計值即可。
真正的全像顯示以空間光調制器重建波前，最大繞射角由像素節距決定：sinθ = λ/(2p)。
optionsEn: A bigger lens gives a hologram both a large screen and a wide viewing angle.
Lens pitch is made to the drawing, so the design value can be used directly in calibration.
A true holographic display reconstructs a wavefront with a spatial light modulator whose maximum diffraction angle is set by the pixel pitch: sinθ = λ/(2p).
quiz.explanation: 真正的全像顯示以空間光調制器重建波前，最大繞射角由像素節距決定：sinθ = λ/(2p)。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A true holographic display reconstructs a wavefront with a spatial light modulator whose maximum diffraction angle is set by the pixel pitch: sinθ = λ/(2p). The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 空間頻寬積與全像視角：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Space–bandwidth product and holographic viewing angle: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「SLM 像素節距與繞射錐」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “SLM pixel pitch and diffraction cone” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：4K LCOS、p = 3.74 µm、λ = 532 nm：sinθ = 0.532/7.48 = 0.0711，θ = 4.08°，全視角僅 8.2°；W = 4096×3.74 µm = 15.3 mm，N = 15.3 mm×0.142/532 nm ≈ 4096。若要 100 mm 寬、40° 視角：N = 0.1×2×sin20°/532×10⁻⁹ ≈ 1.29×10⁵ 每軸，節距 p = λ/(2sin20°) ≈ 0.78 µm，二維共 1.65×10¹⁰ 像素，60 Hz 三色約 3×10¹² 像素/秒。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 4K LCOS with p = 3.74 µm and λ = 532 nm, sinθ = 0.532/7.48 = 0.0711, θ = 4.08° and the full viewing angle is only 8.2°; W = 4096×3.74 µm = 15.3 mm and N = 15.3 mm×0.142/532 nm ≈ 4096. A 100 mm wide window with a 40° viewing angle needs N = 0.1×2×sin20°/532×10⁻⁹ ≈ 1.29×10⁵ per axis at a pitch p = λ/(2sin20°) ≈ 0.78 µm, 1.65×10¹⁰ pixels in two dimensions, or about 3×10¹² pixels per second at 60 Hz in three colours. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在 SLM 上寫入最高空間頻率的二元光柵（每兩像素一週期），於傅立葉平面用相機量 ±1 階的角位置，確認 θ 與 λ/(2p) 相符；再以相機在觀看窗內不同位置拍攝同一全像，記錄可見影像的角範圍與邊緣亮度衰減，並與像素孔徑的 sinc² 包絡比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Write the highest-frequency binary grating (one period per two pixels) on the SLM, measure the angular position of the ±1 orders in the Fourier plane with a camera and confirm θ agrees with λ/(2p); then photograph the same hologram from several positions inside the viewing window, logging the angular range over which the image is visible and the brightness fall-off at the edges, and compare with the sinc² envelope of the pixel aperture.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: For a 4K LCOS with p = 3.74 µm and λ = 532 nm, sinθ = 0.532/7.48 = 0.0711, θ = 4.08° and the full viewing angle is only 8.2°; W = 4096×3.74 µm = 15.3 mm and N = 15.3 mm×0.142/532 nm ≈ 4096. A 100 mm wide window with a 40° viewing angle needs N = 0.1×2×sin20°/532×10⁻⁹ ≈ 1.29×10⁵ per axis at a pitch p = λ/(2sin20°) ≈ 0.78 µm, 1.65×10¹⁰ pixels in two dimensions, or about 3×10¹² pixels per second at 60 Hz in three colours.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「空間頻寬積與全像視角」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Space–bandwidth product and holographic viewing angle", which statement holds?
options: 只要畫面看起來沒有摩爾紋，映射參數就已經夠準。
只要眼動追蹤夠準，延遲幾十毫秒不影響立體感。
optionsEn: For a 4K LCOS with p = 3.74 µm and λ = 532 nm, sinθ = 0.532/7.48 = 0.0711, θ = 4.08° and the full viewing angle is only 8.2°.
If no moiré is visible, the mapping parameters are accurate enough.
If eye tracking is accurate, tens of milliseconds of latency do not affect the 3D effect.
quiz.explanationEn: For a 4K LCOS with p = 3.74 µm and λ = 532 nm, sinθ = 0.532/7.48 = 0.0711, θ = 4.08° and the full viewing angle is only 8.2°; W = 4096×3.74 µm = 15.3 mm and N = 15.3 mm×0.142/532 nm ≈ 4096. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 空間頻寬積與全像視角：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Space–bandwidth product and holographic viewing angle: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「SLM 像素節距與繞射錐」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “SLM pixel pitch and diffraction cone” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在 SLM 上寫入最高空間頻率的二元光柵（每兩像素一週期），於傅立葉平面用相機量 ±1 階的角位置，確認 θ 與 λ/(2p) 相符；再以相機在觀看窗內不同位置拍攝同一全像，記錄可見影像的角範圍與邊緣亮度衰減，並與像素孔徑的 sinc² 包絡比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Write the highest-frequency binary grating (one period per two pixels) on the SLM, measure the angular position of the ±1 orders in the Fourier plane with a camera and confirm θ agrees with λ/(2p); then photograph the same hologram from several positions inside the viewing window, logging the angular range over which the image is visible and the brightness fall-off at the edges, and compare with the sinc² envelope of the pixel aperture. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了放大畫面在 SLM 後加一組 6× 擴束鏡，螢幕變成 92 mm 寬，但視角同時縮到約 1.4°，觀察者稍微移動頭部影像就消失；產品規格只寫尺寸不寫視角，直到驗收才發現不可用。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A 6× beam expander added after the SLM to enlarge the picture makes the screen 92 mm wide but shrinks the viewing angle to about 1.4°, so the image vanishes with the slightest head movement; the specification listed size but not viewing angle, and the problem surfaced only at acceptance.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在 SLM 上寫入最高空間頻率的二元光柵（每兩像素一週期），於傅立葉平面用相機量 ±1 階的角位置，確認 θ 與 λ/(2p) 相符；再以相機在觀看窗內不同位置拍攝同一全像，記錄可見影像的角範圍與邊緣亮度衰減，並與像素孔徑的 sinc² 包絡比較。
knowledge.textEn: Write the highest-frequency binary grating (one period per two pixels) on the SLM, measure the angular position of the ±1 orders in the Fourier plane with a camera and confirm θ agrees with λ/(2p); then photograph the same hologram from several positions inside the viewing window, logging the angular range over which the image is visible and the brightness fall-off at the edges, and compare with the sinc² envelope of the pixel aperture.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「空間頻寬積與全像視角」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Space–bandwidth product and holographic viewing angle"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在 SLM 上寫入最高空間頻率的二元光柵（每兩像素一週期），於傅立葉平面用相機量 ±1 階的角位置，確認 θ 與 λ/(2p) 相符。
每個參數都在規格內，觀察者看到的深度就一定正確。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Write the highest-frequency binary grating (one period per two pixels) on the SLM, measure the angular position of the ±1 orders in the Fourier plane with a camera and confirm θ agrees with λ/(2p).
If every parameter is in specification, the perceived depth must be correct.
quiz.explanation: 在 SLM 上寫入最高空間頻率的二元光柵（每兩像素一週期），於傅立葉平面用相機量 ±1 階的角位置，確認 θ 與 λ/(2p) 相符；再以相機在觀看窗內不同位置拍攝同一全像，記錄可見影像的角範圍與邊緣亮度衰減，並與像素孔徑的 sinc² 包絡比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Write the highest-frequency binary grating (one period per two pixels) on the SLM, measure the angular position of the ±1 orders in the Fourier plane with a camera and confirm θ agrees with λ/(2p); then photograph the same hologram from several positions inside the viewing window, logging the angular range over which the image is visible and the brightness fall-off at the edges, and compare with the sinc² envelope of the pixel aperture. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 空間頻寬積與全像視角：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Space–bandwidth product and holographic viewing angle: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「SLM 像素節距與繞射錐」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “SLM pixel pitch and diffraction cone” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了放大畫面在 SLM 後加一組 6× 擴束鏡，螢幕變成 92 mm 寬，但視角同時縮到約 1.4°，觀察者稍微移動頭部影像就消失；產品規格只寫尺寸不寫視角，直到驗收才發現不可用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A 6× beam expander added after the SLM to enlarge the picture makes the screen 92 mm wide but shrinks the viewing angle to about 1.4°, so the image vanishes with the slightest head movement; the specification listed size but not viewing angle, and the problem surfaced only at acceptance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：多視角全像必須逐視角校正，因為每個觀看方向只用到總頻寬中的一個子孔徑，各子孔徑的像差與相位誤差並不相同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Multiview holograms must be calibrated view by view because each viewing direction uses only a sub-aperture of the total bandwidth, and the aberration and phase error of each sub-aperture differ.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要加大透鏡，就能同時得到大螢幕與大視角的全像。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A bigger lens gives a hologram both a large screen and a wide viewing angle." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了放大畫面在 SLM 後加一組 6× 擴束鏡，螢幕變成 92 mm 寬，但視角同時縮到約 1.4°，觀察者稍微移動頭部影像就消失；產品規格只寫尺寸不寫視角，直到驗收才發現不可用。
knowledge.textEn: A 6× beam expander added after the SLM to enlarge the picture makes the screen 92 mm wide but shrinks the viewing angle to about 1.4°, so the image vanishes with the slightest head movement; the specification listed size but not viewing angle, and the problem surfaced only at acceptance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「空間頻寬積與全像視角」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Space–bandwidth product and holographic viewing angle" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
透鏡節距照設計圖加工，校正時直接用設計值即可。
為了放大畫面在 SLM 後加一組 6× 擴束鏡，螢幕變成 92 mm 寬，但視角同時縮到約 1.4°，觀察者稍微移動頭部影像就消失。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Lens pitch is made to the drawing, so the design value can be used directly in calibration.
A 6× beam expander added after the SLM to enlarge the picture makes the screen 92 mm wide but shrinks the viewing angle to about 1.4°, so the image vanishes with the slightest head movement.
quiz.explanation: 為了放大畫面在 SLM 後加一組 6× 擴束鏡，螢幕變成 92 mm 寬，但視角同時縮到約 1.4°，觀察者稍微移動頭部影像就消失；產品規格只寫尺寸不寫視角，直到驗收才發現不可用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A 6× beam expander added after the SLM to enlarge the picture makes the screen 92 mm wide but shrinks the viewing angle to about 1.4°, so the image vanishes with the slightest head movement; the specification listed size but not viewing angle, and the problem surfaced only at acceptance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
